sloka: ततो देवसखो नाम पर्वतः पतग आलय ।नाना पक्षि समाकीर्णो विविध द्रुम भूषितः ॥४-४३-१७॥
transliteration: tato devasakho nāma parvataḥ pataga ālaya ।nānā pakṣi samākīrṇo vividha druma bhūṣitaḥ ॥4-43-17॥

translations.english: 'Crossing this lord of hills filled with gold, you should reach the great mountain called Sudarsana.
